goal.insight: Present two parallel timelines — fossil energy retirement events on one track and clean energy milestones on the other — so the viewer can visually trace the acceleration of both tracks converging toward an energy transition

Encode each event as a marker on a horizontal timeline axis (x=year), with vertical position separating fossil (below) from clean (above), marker size mapped to event significance score, marker color mapped to energy sub-type (coal/oil/gas vs solar/wind/hydrogen), and an overlaid area or line showing global electricity generation share by clean energy
Visually highlight the period around 2015–2025 where clean energy milestones densify and fossil retirement events accelerate, making the inflection zone prominent
Show the rising clean energy generation share as a continuous overlay so viewers can connect discrete milestone events to the aggregate shift in electricity mix
Ensure coal, oil, gas, solar, wind, and hydrogen events are visually distinguishable by color so viewers can identify which sub-sectors lead the transition on each track
